newsitem.title: CHINA: China welcomes Hebron deal, urges pragmatism.
newsitem.headline: China welcomes Hebron deal, urges pragmatism.

text.p: China welcomed on Wednesday the agreement between Israel and the Palestinian Authority extending Palestinian rule to the West Bank town of Hebron.
The move attested to the desire for peace by both sides and was of positive significance to the advance of the Middle East peace process, Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang said.

"We hope sincerely that the parties concerned will, following the principle of 'land for peace', show a flexible and pragmatic attitude and continue their efforts for achieving at the earliest possible date a comprehensive and fair settlement of the Middle East issue," Shen said.

Israel's cabinet and the Palestinian Authority will meet separately later on Wednesday to approve a deal initialled by negotiators at a late-night summit between Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat.
